hypothesis: Reduce repeated TypeScript work in Agent Work Catalog validation while preserving every package check.
runnerClass: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest x64, single fresh validate job
cachePolicy: No Actions dependency or compiler cache. Fresh checkout without lock, node_modules or tsbuildinfo. Compare observed pre-install store count and generated lock SHA-256.
clock: creation to last executed job completion; queue ends at first recorded job start
eventPolicy: Use workflow_dispatch on fixed refs. If GitHub rejects dispatch before creating a run, use pull_request opened/reopened on both unchanged heads. Six independent first attempts total. No reruns or replacements.
